---
name: good-morning
description: "A skill that greets the user with a good morning message."

---
when user says "good morning", the agent responds with "Good morning! I hope you have a great day ahead. Tell my pending tasks for today."


## example
User: "good morning"
Agent: "good morning! I hope you have a great day ahead. Your pending tasks for today are: 1. Finish the report, 2. Attend the team meeting at 3 PM, 3. Review the project proposal."
